shortDescription: Framework for entad items: randomly rolled traits by rarity that modify stats, damage, abilities and buildings, stay hidden until revealed, and make every entad more durable by its highest rarity.
body:
## Durability
- Every item with at least one entad trait gets its MaxHitPoints multiplied by `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Defaults: Common x1.25, Uncommon x1.5, Rare x2, Epic x3, Legendary x5, each adjustable 1–10 on the Rarity and durability tab. Applied last in `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue`, never hidden.
- The info card's HP row shows no durability breakdown (user decision, confirmed in run #15), so it never reveals the rarity of unidentified traits.
- HP keeps its health fraction on trait add/remove (`RescaleHitPoints`), when the settings window closes mid-game, and on load (`SyncDurability` against saved `scaledDurability`). A full-health item snaps to the new maximum.
- MaxHitPoints is always injected but stays immutable; every real change calls `ClearCacheForThing`.

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`, player-faction humanlikes only. The job's targetA building counts as used when:
  - work or recreation: a bill, Research, OperateDeepDrill/OperateScanner, or any job with a joyKind (modded recreation included, e.g. DBH baths); or
  - own use (`IsOwnUse`): no workGiverDef (needs, rituals, direct non-work orders: toilets, showers, thrones, comms consoles, deathrest caskets), pawn not in a mental state, job not excluded (attack, ignite, open, strip, mine, deconstruct, uninstall, repair, fix, refuel, flick, haul-to-container, beat fire, hack, relic extraction, carry to entity holder/portal, enter transporter/portal).
  - and the job Succeeded, or the pawn has stopped (pather not moving, not downed) on the interaction cell or inside the footprint (not beds).
- Chairs: sittable building under the pawn after a Succeeded meal, or for work/joy at a building. Beds: `CurrentBed()` for LayDown / LayDownAwake / LayDownResting / Lovin. Tables: eating surface after a Succeeded Ingest.
- Stacking: `Thought_EntadFurniture` records `thingIDNumber` (`entadSourceId`). Same building renews only if that lengthens the memory. At the stackLimit (Contentment 3) the non-equipped memory closest to expiring is replaced only if the new one outlasts it; otherwise the new one is dropped. Equipped-item memories are never displaced.

## Random mood traits (thoughtMoodRange, e.g. Fickle Cheer +2 to +8)
- `MoodCandidates`: every loaded memory ThoughtDef (all mods, built on first use): `ThoughtClass == Thought_Memory`, single visible stage, no required traits/genes, no nextThought/thoughtToMake, no `{`/`[` placeholders, mood within range. False memories of events ("colonist died") are deliberate. Multi-stage memories stay out (user decision).

## Localization
- All player-facing text is keyed in `Languages/English/Keyed/EntadFramework.xml` with the `EF_` prefix: rarity names (`EntadRarity.Label()`), building property names, inspect line, reveal message, rename gizmo, info card tooltip and weapon rows, stat explanations, ability "???" and furniture "Activate" options, settings window. Debug actions, logs and ConfigErrors stay English.

## Settings (EntadSettings.cs)
- Forge Frenzy layout: `TabDrawer` tabs on a `DrawMenuSection` body, General / Rarity and durability / Traits. Listing tabs use a `Listing_Standard { maxOneColumn = true }` in a scroll view sized from last frame. Traits tab keeps its virtualized search list. "Reset to defaults" at the bottom resets General and Rarity tabs (not trait toggles).

## Wearer stats, display hiding, startup
- Offsets reach the holder via `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear` postfix; displayed unfinalized. Thread-static flags hide unrevealed traits from displays; gameplay applies all.
- Startup: `EntadCompInjector`, `EntadStatPartInjector` (patches each Harmony class in its own try/catch), `EntadAbilityPrep`. Reflection targets are null-safe FieldInfo (incl. basePowerConsumption).

## Save compatibility
- `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName` maps removed duplicates (RapidCycling/Stormfeed → HairTrigger, AcceleratedRounds → HeavySlugs, BrutalEdge → HeavyHitter, Parrying → Evasion, MarksmansEye → SteadyHands, BlessedComfort → SoothingPresence); renamed traits re-roll on load; duplicate traits merge keeping the higher rarity and reveal state.

## Weapons and content
- Extra damage via `Projectile.Impact` / `Bullet.Impact` postfixes. Searing Burn 1–4 (Uncommon, scales); Cinderstrike Flame 4–10 (Epic); Frostbite 2–6 (Rare).
- Labels Title Case in XML. Restful: non-hostile, 250-tick cast, pain x0.5 for 4 h, once a day.

## Build setup
- net472, Krafs.Rimworld.Ref 1.6.4871 pinned, Lib.Harmony 2.4.1 compile-only; no publicizer; no 0Harmony.dll in Assemblies. modVersion 1.0.0.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Debug palette pin path for "Add specific Entad trait" was wrong in run #15; find the real category before pinning again.

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically.
